sub_site: hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissue (and paired adjacent liver tissue)

evidence.quote: In total, 115 patients with HCC who underwent hepatectomy at PUMCH were enrolled.
Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) that targets the V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene was performed

controls.types: sampling blank (sterile saline exposed in operating room)

evidence.quote: Four cryovials of sterile saline that was kept exposed in the surgery room during sample collection were used as negative controls
ASVs with a relative abundance of more than 0.5% in the control samples were removed

decontamination.tool: decontam (+ removal of ASVs >0.5% in controls, 10% prevalence filter)

evidence.quote: ASVs of contamination were identified based on the ‘decontam’ algorithm

notes: Genus-level profiles only in figures/supplementary figures; text names only 2 genera (prognostic markers). No converted supplement available. 91 patients; 18 extra tumour samples from multiple lesions in 8 cases. FISH also used. Controls 'sequenced' inferred from use of control-sample abundances in decontamination.
